description: This file is a shell script for testing Git mirror push operations. It defines functions to create repository pairs, invert command success, and executes various test cases to verify the behavior of pushing branches and tags to mirror repositories, including creating, updating, force-updating, and removing references.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Function that executes a command and returns 1 if it succeeds, 0 if it fails.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of repositories, 'main' and 'mirror', initializes them, and links 'main' to 'mirror' via remote.
